title: Chapter 30: Terrain Transformation
content:
Chapter 30: Terrain Transformation

In the chat channel of the lords, bursts of exclamation also erupted at this moment.

"It's a miracle that this coward can survive!"

"I didn't expect that he actually had a mercenary contract. This is cheating."

"Hahaha... This is the funniest joke I've ever heard. Dear lords, who of you hasn't cheated? How can you stand out without a little adventure?"

"This boy is really afraid of death. He can do whatever he wants. Unfortunately, what I need is a general who will lead the charge. If he is not suitable, I will not compete with you."

"Lord of the Earth, can your territory still collect 500 gold coins? Do you want me to forgive the debt? Hahaha..."

"Hmph, Lord Qingyang, you also have a big family to support, so these gold coins should be used as a reward for you. I'm afraid that if you can't pay your wages, the people will rebel!"

The two of them were very angry. The encirclement and suppression mission was over, and most of the lords quit the group chat.

The Sunset Lord did not leave, but said to Lord Zach: "The battle is over. Since Lord Zach, you have rewarded him with a skill book for the Eye of Delusion, then I will give him 3 Instant Teleports." Scroll, as a reward for launching the encirclement and suppression campaign in advance!”

"I will keep an eye on him at any time. In addition, I will pre-invest 2 resource gift packs for him if he wins the battle for the village building order."

"Can."

…

Wang Shuo also learned a lot about the novice trial through his conversation with Wang Yanbing.

The world that Wang Yanbing can know is a metaverse world managed by Lord Zach, the servant of God.

It contains many worlds, and every new life that joins must go through a stage of survival of the fittest.

Only players who can survive will be qualified to enter a larger stage and start a more brilliant life.

The planet he came from, because its technology has developed to the stage of contact with the metaverse, was naturally discovered by Lord Zac, and was then included in the universe under his control.

After knowing this, Wang Shuo took a deep breath. Being dominated by advanced civilization, he could only accept it all silently.

[Children, congratulations on surviving this battle. You have received compensation from Lord Sunset, 3 random teleportation scrolls. I hope you like it. 】

Wang Shuo noticed that there were three more scrolls in the backpack.

Since he had a rough idea of the situation, more questions arose and he wanted to know the answers.

But he held back.

His status was extremely unequal, and he didn't even know what questions to ask Mr. Zach.

After experiencing this battle, he had more things to do next.

The wall near the gate was almost completely collapsed.

Through the system, I checked that 2,100 adobe bricks are needed to repair the fence.

Wang Shuo glanced around. Now that the danger in the territory has been basically eliminated, there is now enough time to build high-end walls with fire bricks.

Let’s eat first and take a rest before talking!

Sitting on the Grand Master's chair in the hall, Wang Shuo ordered a lotus root and pork ribs soup, a small stir-fried beef, and a portion of rice.

While eating, open the [Chat Channel].

The top announcement about Wang Shuo's victory over the Bronze Boss has disappeared.

But the discussion below has not disappeared.

"The boss is so scary. He actually killed the bronze boss. The leopard in my territory. I can't find a way to deal with it now."

"Oh my God, aren't there any monsters around the boss? How did he kill a group of people by himself?"

"Please give me a guide and a video explanation!"

"Inspired by the boss, I decided to take action against the wolves in the territory today. Everyone, cheer me on!"

"Upstairs, I advise you to be careful! I have only challenged a wild wolf once, and I almost turned into a wolf daddy!"

Wang Shuo took a sip of the soup, thought about it, and said to the group:

"The bronze boss in my territory was completely unexpected, and I was lucky enough to defeat it!"

"The boss shows up!"

"Please share your experience."

"+1."

"+2."

…

"+888"

…

I saw that many players wanted Wang Shuo to share the details of the battle, but Wang Shuo couldn't refuse his kindness.

Being able to get more information about beasts will at least give you more experience in the subsequent survival.

"The boss in my territory is a toad..."

Wang Shuo thought for a while, the leader of the sludge monster, I won’t say anything about crocodiles, it’s really hard to believe when he says it.

As for the mercenary contract, Wang Yanbing said that in the novice trial stage, it is almost impossible for anyone to get it. This thing is too high-end and cannot be accessed by other players, so he will not brag to them.

Just one golden-armored warrior caused countless exclamations from below them.

Among them, Zhao Shanhe felt the most profoundly.

The "steel puppet" he left behind is still a little short of materials, but Wang Shuo's golden-armored warriors are already ready to fight for him.

He had no choice but to smile bitterly and said in a private message: "Congratulations, brother Wang, for defeating the bronze boss."

Finally, Wang Shuo warned everyone that in order to solve the security problem of the territory, it is best to have equipment and open more treasure boxes.

After saying that, he silently hung up 150 bronze keys in the trading house.

A few minutes later, adding the bronze key from before, Wang Shuo had another 346 gold coins.

"Oh my god, I got 60 gold coins for 2 gold coins."

"I got a good longbow, now I am more confident in killing wild beasts."

Seeing many players harvest a lot of supplies and equipment, Wang Shuo was also very happy. Everyone is from Blue Star, and he can help as much as he can, and he can also get the income from selling keys, which is the best of both worlds.

After lunch, he also opened 5 bronze treasure chests.

[Gold coins × 60, iron ore × 500, bronze ore × 300, coal × 400, "Energy Tower" construction drawings × 1, cotton × 300, chicks × 20, goats × 10. ]

Wang Shuo was even more happy.

Finally, there are small animals to raise in the breeding farm.

Hurry up and put the lambs and chickens into the breeding farm. Wang Shuo also specially used a wall to separate the breeding farm.

It can only be placed like this for the time being, and they will be placed farther away later.

By the way, I checked and found that the crops I planted were growing well. They can be harvested tomorrow.

I got a lot of new materials and can repair the golden warrior first.

I spent 300 gold coins and 400 iron ores.

Next, I explored the swamp in depth and collected some clay to make fire bricks.

He went to the south, the territory of the crocodiles.

At present, the crocodiles should have been eliminated.

Wang Shuo was still making rafts and paving the road, and soon he reached the edge of the swamp in the south.

At this moment, Wang Shuo was in front of a "wall of air".

He could no longer move forward. There was a foggy fog in front of him and he could not see anything clearly.

After walking about 500 meters, it seemed that the entire swamp area was about a radius of 550 meters.

When he thought that this area would soon become his territory, Wang Shuo smiled.

Next, he searched the area carefully and found no potential danger.

He only harvested a few nests of crocodile eggs and some small crocodiles less than half a meter long.

Wang Shuo did not intend to tame these little crocodiles, so he killed them all directly.

Then he took out the "terrain change" scroll and used only one scroll to turn this swamp into a plain.

At this time, the water in the swamp directly squeezed into the swamps on both sides.

Looking at the newly formed land in front of him, Wang Shuo fell into deep thought.

He must use a wall to enclose his territory.

This way he can feel more secure.

The idea is great!

But the workload is huge.

Let's explore the territory!

Came to the eastern area, where the toad lives.

There is no danger inside either.

He used this area as an area to get clay and built a huge pond by the way.

He worked until the evening, and he collected 10,000 pieces of clay, and the pond also took shape.

Tomorrow he will continue to build a brick kiln here, so that he can burn the kiln on the spot and make bricks and tiles.

Back in the shelter, Wang Shuo rested early.
